items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: Charlie and I. We were playing with him... So this was before Mr. Bellson cut up his living room and made two bedrooms for Charlie and I

ctx.x: Yes, well now, Charles was the type person, he would organize a group for a date but he was never there. He would put a band director in charge, you know. But he would do the hiring but he was one of the pet bandmen in his day, you know.
On occasion. Not all the time. But he's --
And then he is said to have had a habit for awhile, which --
